canaries.note: A missed canary invalidates every judged score in the run. The judge is not measuring the property the metric names.

reliability.kappa_note: NOT COMPUTABLE. Cohen's kappa requires two rater populations; repeated draws from one judge are one population sampled repeatedly. What is measured here is self-consistency, and a judge can be perfectly self-consistent and consistently wrong. Section 6.4's kappa >= 0.60 bar is therefore unmet and unmeasurable, so EVERY judged result in this study is descriptive and none of it has authority over a Tier-2 or Tier-3 endpoint.
